here long looping coils replace them — the face becomes even less outlined and more accumulated."},{"slot":"W057","whyHere":"Pale radiating spikes dissolve the head's boundary into the warm looping background; two mismatched spiked circles and barred rectangles suggest face-parts arranged rather than drawn as a unified form.","transitionFromPrevious":"The previous work dissolves the face through shared line weight; here a grid attempts to reassemble it — but the grid itself refuses to stay tidy."},{"slot":"W129","whyHere":"A tilted rectangular form locks a face-like structure inside a crossing-line grid; spiral eye forms anchor the composition while bars, loose white loops, and dense color hatching press inward around them.","transitionFromPrevious":"The previous work divides into four roughly equal zones; here the whole structure tilts, making the grid feel less like a container and more like another layer of pressure."},{"slot":"W133","whyHere":"Strict rectangular framing — two large boxed spiral eyes, one long zigzag-mouth rectangle — holds the composition together even as cyan, yellow, red, and black lines fill every zone including the background with no empty space.","transitionFromPrevious":"The previous work's grid competes with the marks it contains;
